## Requirement ids

- **SIG-UI-073** (one search index for all entries): the release-level
  `releases/<pub>/search/catalog.sqlite` indexes every entry type in one
  artifact — places, sources, technology concepts, entities, documents,
  dossier pages — and every record compartment carries the same-shape v2
  record index; no surface keeps a private index format.
- **SIG-UI-074** (one gazetteer): place docs come from ONE source —
  the bound `sig.jurisdiction-registry/1` when supplied, else the
  export's `jurisdiction_key_map` interim (the NE gazetteer stays HG-03
  gated); `places_source` is recorded in the descriptor inputs.
  Homonyms keep their parent (`meta.parent` / `context`).
- **SIG-SRCH-004** (jurisdiction names resolve first): `exact_names`
  maps official names, alternates and identifier values (ISO/postal
  codes) to place docs with an `official|alternate|identifier|alias`
  basis — the resolve-first surface the query engine consumes.
- **SIG-SRCH-005** (acronym handling): the `aliases` table carries
  `case_sensitive` + expansion + `source_url` verbatim; a case-sensitive
  key is deliberately ABSENT from `exact_names` so a word-match ("ice")
  can never present as the acronym (ICE). `search_aliases.toml` is data
  with a fail-closed loader.
- **SIG-SRCH-011** (release-verified indexes): every descriptor pins
  `publication_id` + `release_label` + `as_of_world` + hashed inputs
  (aliases, sources registry, key map / registry, technology vocab);
  `verify_search_index` streams 1 MiB chunks and refuses
  `integrity_mismatch` / `index_contract` / `release_mismatch` before
  any `mode=ro` open.
- Cited: SIG-UI-039/040 (no route touched — page-type posture
  unchanged), SIG-ENG-042 (fail-closed validation, honest scope
  counters), SIG-SRCH-007 (`name_basis` marks derived names).

## What landed

- `exports/src/exports/search_index_v2.py` (~1,030 lines): the v2
  builder — `build_record_index_v2` (contentless weighted FTS5
  `porter unicode61 remove_diacritics 2`, bm25 name 10 / place 2 /
  source 1; `name_basis` marking; P35.66 public-layer refusal before any
  byte) + `claim_ref.sqlite` (`claim BLOB PRIMARY KEY … WITHOUT ROWID`,
  UUIDs → 16 bytes) + `build_catalog_index` (FTS + `prefix='2 3'` +
  trigrams + `exact_names` + `aliases`) + the doc loaders
  (`place_docs_from_registry`/`_from_key_map`,
  `source_docs_from_registry`, `technology_docs_from_vocab`,
  `entity_docs`, `document_docs_from_evidence`, `page_docs`) +
  `load_search_aliases` + `verify_search_index` /
  `check_index_contract_v2` / `streaming_sha256`. Determinism: fixed
  page size, journal off, application id `SIG2`, sorted inserts.
- `exports/src/exports/data/search_aliases.toml`: 11 seeded rows —
  case-sensitive ICE, CBP, DHS, FBI, HSI, RTCC, LEARN; case-insensitive
  ALPR, LPR, ANPR, CCTV (technology targets bound to the committed
  vocabulary slugs).
- `exports/src/exports/release.py` (+182 lines): additive emit —
  `r/<pub>/c/<comp>/search_index_v2.sqlite` + `search_index_v2.json` +
  `claim_ref.sqlite` per compartment; `releases/<pub>/search/
  catalog.sqlite` + `catalog.json` + `aliases.json`; new kwargs
  `technology_vocab_path` / `search_aliases_path` /
  `jurisdiction_registry_path`. The v1 `search_index` artifacts and the
  descriptor's `search_index_version` pin are unchanged (dual-emit
  interim; SRCH-03 flips serving).
- `CHANGELOG.md` (SIG-REL-014 entry) — added in the fix arc.
- `tests/exports/test_search_index_v2.py` — 25 tests.
